universities.summary: Annamalai University is a public state university established in 1929 at Annamalainagar, Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu. These listings cover 73 regular own-taught degree routes: the preserved agriculture and Villupuram extension offerings plus own-campus postgraduate and five-year integrated degrees in arts, social sciences, languages, sciences, commerce, music and dance. Affiliated-college and distance education admissions are separate.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Faculty of Agriculture has an experimental farm, orchard, livestock farm, agro-meteorological observatory and automatic weather station. Its departments include Agronomy, Entomology, Plant Pathology, Agricultural Microbiology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Economics and Extension Education. The separate Villupuram PG Extension Centre lists computing and science laboratories, NSS, sports, cultural activities and field visits for its own regular students.
universities.cityProfile: The main campus is at Annamalainagar in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, with postal code 608002. The university also runs a PG Extension Centre at Salamedu, Villupuram; those programmes have a separate campus and admission prospectus.
universities.practicalExposure: Agriculture master’s students complete major, minor, supporting and common coursework, a seminar and supervised thesis research under an advisory committee. The common regulations allocate 30 of 70 credits to thesis research and require 80%attendance separately in theory and practical subjects. The separate Villupuram centre lists an exclusive computer laboratory and laboratories for Chemistry, Zoology and Biotechnology, alongside field visits and special lectures.
universities.hostelOverview: Hostel accommodation is available for agriculture students. The historical 2025-26 annual hostel-and-mess charges were 60000 INR for the men’s Sekizhar Block with attached bathroom and 50000 INR for Thamarai Illam women’s hostel, plus 5000 INRcaution deposit. Current charges and room allotment need a new quotation; category-specific concessions have separate conditions. Villupuram extension-centre applicants should request that centre’s current accommodation arrangements separately; main-campus agriculture hostel charges do not establish a Villupuram place.
universities.studentSupport: The Faculty of Agriculture has postgraduate advisory committees and career preparation. The Villupuram PG Extension Centre lists subject faculty, computing/science laboratories and a placement cell. Confirm the exact campus, academic supervisor, required documents and student services for the chosen programme.

programmes.officialTitle: M.A. English — PG Extension Centre, Villupuram

fee.notes: The 2026–27 Villupuram prospectus publishes first-year tuition plus other fees. Obtain the component breakdown, second-year charges, concessions and accommodation costs before payment.

eligibleAudiences: Applicants meeting the exact recognised prior-degree, subject and cycle-specific age conditions
restrictions: 2026–27 age 20–28 on 20 August 2026, with five-year SC/SCA/ST relaxation; future cycles require their own notice.
Equivalent and foreign qualifications need separate university assessment; unrestricted overseas eligibility is not established.
audienceEligibility.notes: Own regular Salamedu Villupuram centre. Programme operation is subject to a minimum number of students; selection uses qualifying-exam performance and an interview.

admissionsContent.overview: M.A. English is a two-year regular programme at Annamalai University’s own PG Extension Centre, Salamedu, Villupuram. This is a separate teaching centre from the main Chidambaram agriculture campus.

eligibility.intro: The current extension-centre prospectus gives these programme-specific prior-degree and cycle-specific age conditions.
items: Pass in a bachelor’s degree with English under Part III, or pass in BA, BSc or BOL with English under Part II.
For SC/ST candidates, a pass is the minimum academic qualification for these programmes.
For 2026–27 entry: age 20–28 as on 20 August 2026; five-year age relaxation for SC/SCA/ST candidates.

applicationSteps: Follow the next official university PG Extension Centre admission announcement; the 2026 application deadline has passed.

faq.question: Is Annamalai University public or private?
faq.answer: It is a public state university at Annamalainagar, Chidambaram, established in 1929. UGC lists the institution as a State University; recognition of a university is distinct from any programme-specific professional accreditation.

faq.question: Which agriculture admission route applies?
faq.answer: The eligibility conditions below apply to Indian applicants with a four-year B.Sc. (Ag.) or B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture degree using regular TNAU admissions. Other prior degrees and foreign-national admission require separate assessment. The four-year qualifying degree, institution category, academic marks and entrance selection all need to be met.

faq.question: Are the Agriculture master’s taught in English?
faq.answer: The Faculty of Agriculture’s 2019-20 policy specifies English instruction. Regular teaching and thesis research are combined in its master’s programmes.

faq.question: How are Agriculture master’s students selected?
faq.answer: TNAU conducts the regular postgraduate admissions process and common entrance examination. Final admission remains conditional on academic eligibility, original records, selection and the relevant allotment.

faq.question: What is the Agriculture intake baseline?
faq.answer: Annamalai scheduled first-year M.Sc. Agriculture classes for 22 October 2026 at 10 am. That historical date does not announce a future intake; the next application and class-start schedule must be newly notified.

faq.question: What should I budget for Agriculture study?
faq.answer: Obtain a current full fee quotation for the chosen aided or self-supporting category. Include tuition, compulsory charges, hostel, mess, deposits and examination costs; a historic combined annual charge is not a current tuition figure.

faq.question: How do aided and self-supporting options differ?
faq.answer: The current admission notification advertises both categories for the same agriculture specialisations. Their charges differ, so compare the admission category and complete budget before choosing; neither category guarantees admission or employment.

faq.question: Which programmes are offered at the Villupuram PG Extension Centre?
faq.answer: The university’s own centre at Salamedu, Villupuram, lists two-year regular MA English, MCom and MSc Mathematics, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Zoology and Computer Science. These programmes have a separate qualification table, interview process and fee schedule from the Chidambaram agriculture routes.

faq.question: What are the Villupuram entry conditions and first-year charges?
faq.answer: Each programme has a specific qualifying degree and, where stated, a main-subject mark requirement. For the 2026–27 cycle, applicants must be 20–28 on 20 August 2026, with five-year SC/SCA/ST relaxation; SC/ST candidates need a pass as the minimum academic qualification. Selection uses qualifying-exam performance and an interview. The prospectus lists first-year tuition plus other charges from ₹5,350 to ₹26,650 by degree. Its 20 August 2026 application deadline has passed; future applicants need the next notice.

faq.question: Do the five-year integrated degrees require a bachelor’s degree?
faq.answer: They enter after HSC/Class 12 or equivalent. The named prospectus specifies subjects for science and commerce routes, age and category conditions, qualifying-exam assessment plus interview, and a minimum 20-student condition. These are complete integrated awards; separately admitting intermediate exit degrees are not listed.

faq.question: Are all main-campus degrees taught in English?
faq.answer: English is stated for the named five-year integrated group in the latest published 2025–26 prospectus and for the preserved agriculture routes in their own rules. The Marine Sciences 2025–26 prospectus also specifies English for its three MSc degrees at Parangipettai. Teaching language has not been verified for the newly added two-year main-campus degrees; confirm with the exact department.

faq.question: What do the integrated programme fee figures cover?
faq.answer: They are indicative first-year tuition and other fees from the latest published 2025–26 integrated prospectus. They do not establish current recurring annual tuition or the whole five-year cost. Confirm the current category fee demand, compulsory hostel/mess charges, deposits and any concession assessment.

faq.question: Which routes are included in the broader main-campus listing?
faq.answer: The expansion covers academic arts, social science, language, commerce, library science, science, music and dance degrees with verified named entry rules. It does not infer approval or professional practice rights for unresolved engineering, pharmacy, teacher-training, clinical or other regulated routes.

admissionsContent.scope: 73 regular own-taught degree routes: eight preserved main-campus Agriculture MSc and seven preserved SalameduVillupuram extension masters, plus 41 Annamalainagar graduate-entry degrees, three Parangipettai marine degrees and 14 five-year integrated degrees. Exact campus, award level, academic prerequisites and applicant categories remain offering-specific. Unresolved professional routes, affiliated colleges and distance/online study are excluded.

evidence.claimText: Annamalai University is a public state university established in 1929 at Annamalainagar, Chidambaram. Its regular agriculture master’s programmes combine specialist coursework with supervised thesis research. Indian agriculture graduates apply through TNAU counselling; aided and self-supporting categories have different costs. Teaching is in English and study requires campus attendance.
evidence.sourceLabel: Annamalai official source

evidence.claimText: The Faculty of Agriculture has an experimental farm, orchard, livestock farm, agro-meteorological observatory and automatic weather station. Its departments include Agronomy, Entomology, Plant Pathology, Agricultural Microbiology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Economics and Extension Education.
evidence.sourceLabel: Annamalai official source

evidence.claimText: The main campus is at Annamalainagar in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, with postal code 608002. The university also runs a PG Extension Centre at Salamedu, Villupuram; those programmes have a separate campus and admission prospectus.
evidence.sourceLabel: Annamalai official source

evidence.claimText: Agriculture master’s students complete major, minor, supporting and common coursework, a seminar and supervised thesis research under an advisory committee. The common regulations allocate 30 of 70 credits to thesis research and require 80%attendance separately in theory and practical subjects.
evidence.sourceLabel: Annamalai official source

evidence.claimText: Hostel accommodation is available for agriculture students. The historical 2025-26 annual hostel-and-mess charges were 60000 INR for the men’s Sekizhar Block with attached bathroom and 50000 INR for Thamarai Illam women’s hostel, plus 5000 INRcaution deposit. Current charges and room allotment need a new quotation; category-specific concessions have separate conditions.
evidence.sourceLabel: Annamalai official source

evidence.claimText: The Faculty of Agriculture has a placement cell for career preparation and employer interaction. Postgraduate advisory committees guide course planning and thesis research. Students Traffic can help assess the degree route, required records and total study budget.
evidence.sourceLabel: Annamalai official source
